pricing_notes: Standard processing tier, short-context prices (prompts up to 272,000 input tokens). cache_read is the 'cached input' rate. cache_write is the '30m write' rate the pricing page lists for the GPT-6 family; the '12h write' rate is 2.5x base input. Prompts over 272,000 tokens are billed at higher long-context prices: only the flagship's are modelled here, in its 'over' block (its long-context cache write rate was not captured). Batch, Flex, Fast and regional pricing are not modelled. The tier-to-model mapping is this project's choice, made by price; the effort values are plain labels to map to your own reasoning setting. Prices change: check the source before relying on these.
